sourcesContent: import Tag from '../Tag' import { Card, Descricao, Titulo, Infos } from './styles' type Props = { title: string category: string system: string description: string infos: string[] image: string } const Product = ({ description, image, infos, title }: Props) => ( {infos.map((info) => ( {info} ))} {title} {description} ) export default Product
